name: Hiyami Masato
source: A student of Tsukinoka High School's class I-A. Born with a weak body, Masato was forced to change schools repeatedly due to his illness and frequent hospital visits. Originally a cheerful, upbeat, never-say-die type of youth who was well liked by his peers. His transfer to a middle-of-nowhere land with no community to speak of has affected his maturation to adulthood. Masato attended his third year in elementary school in the same class as Ayame and Chiyomi where they got along well.
translation: 月之丘高中I年A班学生。雅人天生体弱，因疾病和频繁住院被迫多次转学。他原本是开朗积极、永不言败、深受同学喜爱的少年。转学到一个偏僻、几乎没有社区的地方后，他的成长受到了影响。小学三年级时，他与绫和千代同班，关系很好。
